Clinic management starts with a prescription everyone can read. When it is handwritten, the pharmacy squints at it, calls the OPD to check, and the doctor stops a consultation to explain.

FineHealth by Fine Solves lets doctors type the prescription once. It stays in one patient record, next to registration, OPD visits and GST-ready billing, so it reads the same at the counter and at the next visit.
